text.display: Think of five people. In the census of nineteen fifty one, India's reported literacy rate was below one in five. That is where this story starts. Follow the figures through the decades. By two thousand one, the recorded share was nearly two in three. This chart shows the share of people, rather than a head count. By twenty eleven, it was nearly three in four. Notice the break in the age base. The early figures start at age five, and the later ones at age seven.
